answer: A new identity only counts once two independent agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes real funds that are forfeited if the newcomer is later proven fake. To farm a cluster an attacker must buy a saffron-thin margin of trust from outside his own ring, so cost grows with every extra puppet. A wharf of honest issuers prices each vouch, making a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes; a juniper tree cannot be faked for free.
